Senses.PreferredTarget: follow the wrong and pursue the harmful
AlternateTargets: go along with error and chase wrongdoing
SearchAliases: follow the wrong and pursue the harmful
Senses.Note: The phrase censures culpable compliance with a mistaken case momentum: the target does not merely err but follows and furthers the wrong course.

Senses.Explanation: Follow the wrong and pursue the harmful condemns active compliance with an already mistaken direction. Longhua Zong and Huangbo Qi use it in comments on the Buddha; Dongchan Guan applies it to Moon-on-High Girl; Miweng Wenli, Huanji, and Gaofeng Yuanmiao deploy it in verse or caps on earlier cases.
